item.title: PM Jan Dhan Yojana 2026: Zero Balance Account Benefits, Overdraft Rules & Online Registration Guide
item.description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) 2026 allows Indian citizens to open zero-balance bank accounts with built-in ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover and a free RuPay debit card. Eligible account holders can also access an overdraft facility of up to ₹10,000 after 6 months of active account usage. Here is the complete blueprint covering eligibility rules, document requirements, and application procedures.
